summary.text: Terry Baker is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 1C who has served since January 11, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Baker graduated from Williamsport High School in 1973, earned an A.A. from Hagerstown Junior College in 1975, and earned a B.S. in education from Auburn University in 1978.
His career experience includes working as a student trades coordinator, and he served on the Washington County Commission and as assistant mayor of Clear Spring.
Baker succeeded Mike McKay in the House of Delegates and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Environment and Transportation Committee.
